description: One call answers "is this domain's email properly secured?" — checks MX, SPF, DMARC and mail-gateway/provider detection for ONE domain. The differentiator vs a plain DNS resolver. Use when the user asks about email deliverability, spoofing protection, SPF/DMARC posture, or "is email set up correctly". Prefer this over dns_lookup, spf_analyze or dmarc_check for any "is the email secure / well-configured" question — it returns a graded verdict with prioritized fixes, followed by every underlying DNS record (complete by default; detail="concise" for the grade + key records only). For DKIM signing keys, use dkim_discover. One domain per call.

detail.description: Output detail. Default (omit, or "full") returns the graded posture PLUS every underlying DNS record untruncated. "concise" returns the grade, checks, fixes and the MX/SPF/DMARC records only.

domain.description: The single domain to assess, e.g. "acme.com".

name: email_security_check
